PatchLab can exchange the patch with Lightwright and Vectorworks, in both directions. Open the Tasks page, and click Open exchange.
Choose the program. Export writes a file with one row per LK or Veam port: the circuit name, the position, and the universe.
Import that file in Lightwright or Vectorworks, and match on the circuit name. The note under the button tells you where.
After you changed things there, export the same list again, and choose it here with Choose file.
PatchLab matches every row, and shows what differs: universe, or position. Everything else is left alone.
Tick the changes you want, and press Apply. They are written into the patch, and validation runs again.
Rows that exist only in the file can be added as new lines. Rows that exist only in PatchLab are counted, but never removed.
